Name: Custom Splash Screen
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default this mod just replaces the splash screen's white background with a black background.

You can change the color in the config. If you set the color's A value to 0, it will show a prismatic background;


[b][size=5]Images
[/size][/b]
You can replace the background with a static png image file by naming the image [b]splash.png[/b] and placing it in the mod folder.

You can make the mod choose a random png image file by creating a folder called [b]Images[/b] and placing any number of png files in that folder.


[b][size=5]Music[/size][/b]

You can set the main menu music and set it to start when the splash screen appears, in the config.


[b][size=5]Config[/size][/b]

You can use GMCM to edit the config in-game.

You need GMCM Options installed to change the color in-game.


[b][size=5]Technical
[/size][/b]
Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url]
